narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: {model_monica} mentioned the current workflow during our sync. When a new model version is ready, she manually copies the artifact file to the shared storage bucket. She then opens the internal wiki page and types the version number, training date, and hyperparameter settings into a text box. There is no automated link between the training job and the registry entry. If a model is retrained, she repeats the manual copy and update process from scratch. The registry remains a static list of text entries. No system validates the file format or checks for duplicate version numbers before she saves the page. The process relies entirely on her remembering to update the wiki after every successful training run.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current manual workflow and its limitations as an objective observation without expressing any specific wish, refusal, acceptance, or trade-off by the author.
